candidates.name: Barbell Roll Outs
candidates.cardText:
Barbell Roll Outs
Advanced
1
Hold the Barbell with both hands and kneel on the floor with your feet up
2
Slowly roll the Barbell straight forward, stretching your body into a straight position.
3
After a pause at the stretched position, start pulling yourself back to the starting position. This should be a slow and controlled movement.

candidates.name: Barbell Situp
candidates.cardText:
Barbell Situp
Intermediate
1
Hold the bar with a slightly wider than shoulder width grip. Push the bar up toward the ceiling and maintain that elbow extension.
2
Flex your abs and sit-up. Aim to get your torso vertical while maintaining the barbell overhead.

candidates.name: Barbell Front Squat Olympic
candidates.cardText:
Barbell Front Squat Olympic
Advanced
1
Measure your hands by the markings on the bar to make sure you're even. Then throw your elbows underneath the bar.
2
The bar should be set so high on your shoulders it digs into your neck a bit. Make sure to push your elbows up to the ceiling for the entire rep. To make sure you don't get too pitched forward.
3
Use the squat stance you would use for a back or goblet squat. Push your hips back to initiate the squat. Break at the knees until you hit parallel depth.
4
Squat back up to a standing position.

candidates.name: Landmine Sit Up
candidates.cardText:
Landmine Sit Up
Intermediate
1
Lay flat on the ground and hold the end of the bar with your arms extended.
2
Raise your back off the ground until you are sitting at a 90 degree angle.
3
Then lower slowly back to the floor.

candidates.name: Landmine Hollow Hold
candidates.cardText:
Landmine Hollow Hold
Advanced
1
Start by lying flat on your back with your legs extended towards the landmine attachment and your arms overhead, holding the landmine barbell with both hands while engaging your core muscles by pressing your lower back into the ground and drawing your belly button in towards your spine.
2
Lift your legs off the ground, keeping them together and straight, and simultaneously raise your upper body off the ground, reaching the landmine barbell away from your face.
3
Hold this position for the desired duration, then carefully lower the barbell to the ground.

candidates.name: Barbell Larsen Bench Press
candidates.cardText:
Barbell Larsen Bench Press
Advanced
1
Start in a bench press position with your legs elevated. Try to keep your knees with a slight bend in them.
2
Unrack the bar then initiate the rep.
3
Bring the bar to your torso and tap your ribcage before pressing back to the ceiling.

candidates.name: Barbell Hooklying Bench Press
candidates.cardText:
Barbell Hooklying Bench Press
Advanced
1
Start in a bench press position with your feet planted on the bench and knees bent.
2
Grasp the barbell with an overhand grip, positioning your hands slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
3
Lift the barbell off the rack and lower it to your chest, keeping your elbows close to your sides.
4
Push the barbell back up to the starting position, fully extending your arms.
